scripts.build: node --eval "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.db:migrate: cross-env RUST_LOG=info prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cross-env RUST_LOG=info prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:reset: cross-env RUST_LOG=info prisma migrate reset --schema prisma/schema.prisma --force
